fields.Name: T100 - Query Info Panel and Rendered SQL View
fields.Description: Exercises the mj-query-info-panel slide-in (OpenInfoPanel) with its accordion metadata + read-only SQL code editor — the 'rendered SQL view' — distinct from running the query or the generic record form.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to Data Explorer, and open the Queries section. Select any Approved query (green status dot) from the folder tree so it opens in the right-hand viewer. In the viewer's header click the 'Info' button to open the Query Information slide-in panel. Expand the accordion sections — especially 'SQL Query' (which renders the query's SQL in a read-only code editor) plus 'Fields' and 'Parameters'. Success is seeing the Info panel render with its metadata accordions and the read-only SQL shown when you expand the SQL Query section — you do NOT need to edit anything. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Query Information slide-in panel opens with accordion sections (Overview, Fields, Parameters, SQL Query)
Expanding the 'SQL Query' section shows the query's SQL text in a read-only code editor (or a clear 'SQL not available' empty state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
